quote: Except when overtaking and passing on the right is permitted, the driver of an overtaken vehicle shall give way to the right in favor of the overtaking vehicle upon observing the overtaking vehicle or hearing a signal. The driver of an overtaken vehicle shall not increase the speed of the vehicle until completely passed by the overtaking vehicle.

activation.condition: A driver in an overtaken vehicle observes the overtaking vehicle or hears its signal.

obligation.description: Give way to the right in favor of the overtaking vehicle when the stated exception does not apply; separately do not increase speed until completely passed.

exceptions.source_clause: Except when overtaking and passing on the right is permitted
exceptions.description: The stated exception is confined to the give-way sentence; its application requires separate right-pass authority, roadway, safety, and paved-path review.

timing.description: Give-way duty follows actual observation or hearing; speed increase remains barred until complete passing.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure original full-body rightward displacement without a legal displacement threshold.
Original camera pixels and frame joins may support later observation review; visibility alone does not prove actual observation.
Original command and generated envelope do not prove propagation or subjective hearing.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: completely passed by the overtaking vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: Bracket full-body passing from original corners and retain between-frame uncertainty.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: overtaking and passing on the right is permitted
judgment_calls_needed.note: Record separate statutory source and surveyed road facts while leaving safety and permission undecided.
